text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship is finally about to 
begin. Aiming for the greatest finale, 
Fine Motion vows to run a race that will 
linger in everyone's hearts.

Kawakami Princess declares she will face 
her full-on as a "rival." Fine Motion has 
no intention of giving up the win either.

How will the "Princess? Showdown" play 
out...? The battle begins now—!
